英譯中：Translate the following passage into Chinese（20 分）According to a 2026 report published by Travel Weekly Asia, travelagents in Thailand strongly opposed the government’s proposal to impose adeparture tax of approximately US$30 on Thai travelers. The governmentestimated that the tax could generate significant revenue to support domestictourism programs. However, travel industry representatives argued that theadditional charge could increase travel costs and place more pressure on thetourism sector during a period of economic uncertainty and rising expensesrelated to the Middle East conflict. The Thai Travel Agents Association alsoquestioned how the revenue would be managed and allocated. The proposedtax would apply only to Thai citizens and would be separate from the existingtourism tax charged to inbound international visitors.

中譯英：Translate the following passage into English（20 分）交通部觀光署行政資訊網是臺灣重要的觀光行政與公共資訊平臺，主要提供觀光政策、法規公告、行政程序、觀光統計資料與政府相關計畫等資訊。網站內容涵蓋旅行業、旅館業、民宿業以及導遊領隊等觀光產業管理資訊，也提供觀光產業輔導與旅遊安全相關內容。此外，行政資訊網也提供觀光市場分析、研究報告、國際觀光推廣政策與觀光發展計畫，方便政府單位、觀光業者、研究人員與民眾查詢與使用。此平臺有助於提升政府資訊透明度與行政效率，同時促進臺灣觀光產業的發展與管理。

Write an English essay in 250 to 300 words（40 分）Write an essay of about 300 words to discuss “How can wars andinternational conflicts affect global tourism development?” In your essay,discuss the impacts of the 2026 military conflict involving the United States,Israel, and Iran on tourism, airlines, and international travel. You may alsoprovide examples and suggestions for how the tourism industry can respondto global crises.
